purpose: Select one fit-diagnostic window using shared physical flow and shared rendered texture only

selection_rule.eligible_pixels: shared flow_valid AND magnitude(flow_forward_30ms_px) >= 0.5 source px per 30ms AND Sobel magnitude of linearized-display-proxy Rec.709 luma > 1/255
selection_rule.winner: highest score; earliest window index breaks ties

fit_budget_reference: configs/stage5_flow_fixed_sample_fit_v1.json (200 updates per arm, same seed 0 initialization, no augmentation)
protocol_scope: bounded synthetic GT-supervised mechanism diagnostic only; does not change formal self-supervised objective, checkpoint selection, or real-test policy
